Molecular Atlas DNA model templates

Derived from the BioExcel biobb_amber NAB reference fixture, distributed under Apache License 2.0. See BIOEXCEL-LICENSE.txt in this directory.

Reference repository: https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_amber
Reference commit: 35751118940efeccc430cb53c96b174c6ba7b52c
Reference file: biobb_amber/test/reference/nab/ref_nab_build_dna_structure.pdb
Builder commit: bf9be6288f10f0d44077058c35fb84148c166a63

Atlas modifications: recover eight nucleotide templates with inverse helical transforms; omit hydrogen atoms; assemble the chosen gene sequence and its antiparallel complement; omit 5-prime terminal phosphate groups; centre and rotate the model for display.

These are constructed ideal B-DNA coordinates, not a measured structure of the selected gene.
